title: 11 Best Herbal Creams For Asthma
intro: Herbal creams for Asthma are topical preparations made from various plant extracts that help alleviate symptoms associated with asthma. These creams provide numerous benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving congestion, and soothing the airways, ultimately providing relief to individuals suffering from asthma. Some examples of herbal creams used to treat asthma include Eucalyptus oil-infused creams, which help clear mucus and open airways, Thyme-based creams, which exhibit antimicrobial properties to combat infections, and Ginger-based creams, which reduce inflammation and improve breathing. Additionally, other herbal creams like Peppermint, Lavender, and Rosemary have also been used to treat asthma due to their anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, making them effective natural alternatives to traditional medications.

preparations.preparation_desc: Eucalyptus globulus creams have been widely used as a natural remedy to alleviate asthma symptoms due to their anti-inflammatory and decongestant properties. These herbal preparations help to treat asthma by loosening and expelling mucus from the airways, thereby reducing inflammation and congestion. The bioactive constituents of Eucalyptus globulus, including eucalyptol, alpha-pinene, and limonene, play a crucial role in its therapeutic effects, acting as bronchodilators and anti-inflammatory agents. The benefits of using Eucalyptus globulus creams to treat asthma include reduced respiratory distress, improved lung function, and a decrease in the frequency and severity of asthma attacks.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Journal of ethnopharmacology", Eucalyptus globulus creams for asthma may be beneficial due to the presence of active compounds that inhibit mast-cell degranulation, as indicated by a study showing that alcoholic extracts of Eucalyptus globulus leaves inhibited IgE-dependent histamine release from RBL-2H3 cells by more than 80% for extract concentrations of 0.5 mg/ml.

preparations.preparation_desc: Rosmarinus officinalis creams have been traditionally used to treat asthma symptoms due to their anti-inflammatory and bronchodilatory properties, which help to relax airway muscles and improve respiratory function. The bioactive constituents of Rosmarinus officinalis, such as carnosic acid and rosmarinic acid, play a crucial role in reducing inflammation and modulating the immune response, thereby alleviating asthma symptoms. By inhibiting the release of histamine and other pro-inflammatory mediators, Rosmarinus officinalis creams help to reduce bronchospasm and improve lung function in individuals with asthma. The regular use of Rosmarinus officinalis creams has been associated with several benefits, including reduced frequency and severity of asthma attacks, improved quality of life, and enhanced respiratory health.

Echinacea purpurea creams have been traditionally used to treat asthma, leveraging their anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory properties to help alleviate symptoms. The bioactive constituents of Echinacea purpurea, including alkylamides, glycoproteins, and caffeic acid derivatives, are believed to contribute to its therapeutic effects. These compounds help to reduce inflammation and modulate the immune response, which can help to alleviate asthma symptoms such as wheezing and shortness of breath. The benefits of using Echinacea purpurea creams to treat asthma include reduced reliance on pharmaceutical medications and improved overall respiratory health.
preparations.preparation_study: According to the given study, Echinacea purpurea creams have potential for adjuvant symptomatic therapy in respiratory conditions, including asthma.

preparations.preparation_desc: Lavandula angustifolia creams have been traditionally used to treat asthma due to their anti-inflammatory and bronchodilatory properties, which help to relax the airway muscles and improve breathing. The bioactive constituents of Lavandula angustifolia, including linalool and linalyl acetate, have been found to possess bronchodilatory and anti-inflammatory effects, contributing to its therapeutic benefits in asthma treatment. By reducing inflammation and relaxing airway muscles, Lavandula angustifolia creams help to alleviate asthma symptoms, making it a popular natural remedy for managing this condition. The benefits of using Lavandula angustifolia creams to treat asthma include reduced symptoms, improved quality of life, and a natural alternative to conventional medications.

Curcuma longa creams have been gaining attention for their potential in treating asthma due to their anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents, including curcumin, demethoxycurcumin, and bisdemethoxycurcumin, in Curcuma longa creams help to inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory enzymes and cytokines, thereby reducing inflammation and oxidative stress in the airways. This herbal preparation helps to treat asthma by relaxing bronchial muscles, reducing mucus production, and improving lung function, ultimately alleviating symptoms such as wheezing and shortness of breath. The benefits of using Curcuma longa creams for asthma treatment include improved lung function, reduced frequency and severity of attacks, and enhanced overall quality of life.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "International journal for vitamin and nutrition research. Internationale Zeitschrift fur Vitamin- und Ernahrungsforschung. Journal international de vitaminologie et de nutrition", Curcuma longa creams may be effective in treating asthma due to its anti-inflammatory properties that reduce tracheal responsiveness to methacholine and ovalbumin and improve lung pathological features in sensitized rats.

preparations.preparation_desc: Zingiber officinale creams, derived from the rhizomes of the ginger plant, have been studied for their potential in treating asthma due to their anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. These properties help to reduce inflammation and oxidative stress in the airways, which are common triggers of asthma symptoms. The bioactive constituents of Zingiber officinale creams, such as gingerols and shogaols, have been shown to inhibit pro-inflammatory enzymes and cytokines, contributing to their therapeutic effects. Regular use of Zingiber officinale creams may help to alleviate asthma symptoms by reducing inflammation, improving lung function, and enhancing overall respiratory health.

Thymus vulgaris creams, also known as thyme creams, have been used to treat asthma symptoms due to their anti-inflammatory and bronchodilatory properties. These properties help to reduce inflammation in the airways and relax the muscles around the bronchi, making it easier to breathe. The bioactive constituents of thyme, including thymol and carvacrol, have been found to inhibit the production of inflammatory mediators and improve lung function, thereby alleviating asthma symptoms. The use of Thymus vulgaris creams has been associated with several benefits, including reduced frequency and severity of asthma attacks, improved quality of life, and reduced reliance on medication.

Ginkgo biloba creams have been explored as a potential treatment for asthma due to their anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce airway inflammation and improve lung function. The herbal preparation contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and bilobalide, which have been shown to have bronchodilatory effects, thereby helping to alleviate asthma symptoms. By reducing inflammation and improving airway function, Ginkgo biloba creams may help to provide relief from asthma attacks and improve overall quality of life for individuals suffering from this condition. The benefits of using Ginkgo biloba creams to treat asthma include reduced reliance on medication, improved lung function, and enhanced overall respiratory health.

Salvia officinalis creams, derived from the leaves of the sage plant, have been traditionally used to treat asthma due to their anti-inflammatory and bronchodilatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Salvia officinalis, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, help to reduce inflammation in the airways, making it easier to breathe and alleviate asthma symptoms. The anti-inflammatory properties of Salvia officinalis creams also help to reduce the production of mucus, thereby relieving congestion and coughing associated with asthma. Regular use of Salvia officinalis creams can provide relief from asthma symptoms and improve the quality of life for individuals suffering from this chronic condition.

Mentha x piperita creams, derived from the peppermint plant, have been used to treat asthma symptoms due to their anti-inflammatory and bronchodilatory properties. The bioactive constituents of mentha x piperita, including menthone and menthol, help to relax the airway muscles, making it easier to breathe and reducing inflammation in the airways. The benefits of using mentha x piperita creams to treat asthma include improved lung function, reduced symptoms of wheezing and coughing, and enhanced overall quality of life. Regular use of mentha x piperita creams can also help to reduce the reliance on conventional medications and promote a more natural approach to managing asthma symptoms.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "The Journal of asthma : official journal of the Association for the Care of Asthma", Mentha x piperita creams, derived from the peppermint plant, may provide relief for asthma symptoms by exerting positive effects on bronchodilation, pulmonary function tests, and antagonism of asthma mediators.

preparations.preparation_desc: Cinchona officinalis creams have been traditionally used to treat asthma due to their anti-inflammatory and bronchodilatory properties, which help to alleviate symptoms such as wheezing and shortness of breath. The herbal preparation contains bioactive constituents like quinine and quinidine, which possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help to reduce inflammation and oxidative stress in the airways, thereby easing asthma symptoms. By relaxing the airway muscles and increasing airflow, Cinchona officinalis creams help to provide relief from asthma attacks and improve lung function. The benefits of using Cinchona officinalis creams to treat asthma include reduced reliance on conventional medications, improved quality of life, and a natural approach to managing respiratory health.

Melissa officinalis creams, derived from the herb lemon balm, have been used to treat asthma symptoms due to their anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. These properties help to reduce inflammation in the airways, alleviate symptoms such as wheezing and shortness of breath, and improve overall respiratory function. The bioactive constituents present in Melissa officinalis creams, including rosmarinic acid and 1,8-cineole, are responsible for these therapeutic effects, which help to relax airway muscles, reduce mucus production, and enhance lung function. The benefits of using Melissa officinalis creams to treat asthma include reduced medication dependence, improved quality of life, and a natural approach to managing symptoms without harsh side effects.

Glycyrrhiza glabra creams have been traditionally used to treat asthma due to their anti-inflammatory and bronchodilatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this herbal preparation, including glycyrrhizin and flavonoids, help to reduce inflammation and relax bronchial muscles, thereby alleviating asthma symptoms. By inhibiting the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines and increasing the levels of anti-inflammatory cytokines, Glycyrrhiza glabra creams help to reduce airway resistance and improve lung function in asthma patients. The benefits of using Glycyrrhiza glabra creams to treat asthma include reduced frequency and severity of asthma attacks, improved quality of life, and a decrease in the need for medication.

Achillea millefolium creams have been traditionally used to treat asthma due to their anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. These herbal preparations help to treat asthma by loosening mucus and reducing inflammation in the airways, thereby making it easier to breathe. The bioactive constituents of Achillea millefolium, such as flavonoids and sesquiterpenes, have been found to possess bronchodilatory and antioxidant activities that aid in the treatment of asthma. The benefits of using Achillea millefolium creams to treat asthma include reduced symptoms, improved lung function, and a decrease in the frequency and severity of asthma attacks.

Artemisia absinthium creams are herbal preparations derived from the leaves and flowers of the wormwood plant, which have been traditionally used to treat asthma and other respiratory ailments. The anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties of this herbal preparation help to reduce inflammation in the airways, relieve bronchospasm, and improve lung function. The bioactive constituents of Artemisia absinthium, including thujone, camphor, and borneol, contribute to its therapeutic effects by exhibiting bronchodilatory, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities. By reducing inflammation and improving lung function, Artemisia absinthium creams provide relief from asthma symptoms, making it a valuable natural remedy for this condition.

Sambucus nigra creams, derived from the elder tree, have been traditionally used to help alleviate symptoms of asthma. The antispasmodic properties of this herbal preparation help to relax the smooth muscles in the airways, thus reducing inflammation and bronchospasm associated with asthma. The bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sambunigrin, in Sambucus nigra creams exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which contribute to their therapeutic effects. By using Sambucus nigra creams, individuals can experience relief from asthma symptoms, including wheezing, coughing, and shortness of breath, and also benefit from their potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.

Cymbopogon citratus creams, extracted from the essential oil of lemongrass, possess anti-inflammatory and bronchodilatory properties that help to treat asthma by reducing inflammation and opening up airways. This herbal preparation helps to treat asthma by soothing the respiratory tract, relieving congestion, and promoting relaxation, ultimately alleviating symptoms such as wheezing and shortness of breath. The bioactive constituents of Cymbopogon citratus creams, including citral, geranial, and limonene, are responsible for their therapeutic effects, as they have been shown to inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory mediators and relax smooth muscle cells in the airways. The benefits of using Cymbopogon citratus creams to treat asthma include reduced symptoms, improved lung function, and a decrease in the need for respiratory medications, making it a natural and effective alternative for managing this chronic condition.

Silybum marianum creams, derived from the milk thistle plant, have been used to treat asthma due to their anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The herbal preparation contains flavonoids, such as silymarin, which help to reduce inflammation in the airways and alleviate symptoms of asthma. Silymarin also exhibits bronchodilatory effects, allowing for easier breathing and improved lung function. The benefits of using Silybum marianum creams to treat asthma include reduced symptoms, improved quality of life, and a natural alternative to conventional medication.

Ephedra sinica creams have been traditionally used to treat asthma due to their bronchodilatory properties, which help to relax the airway muscles and improve airflow to the lungs. This herbal preparation is believed to help treat asthma by reducing inflammation, modulating the immune system, and alleviating symptoms such as wheezing and shortness of breath. The bioactive constituents of Ephedra sinica creams, including ephedrine and pseudoephedrine, are responsible for their therapeutic effects, as they act as decongestants and bronchodilators to ease breathing. The benefits of using Ephedra sinica creams to treat asthma include rapid relief from symptoms, improved lung function, and reduced reliance on conventional medications.

Piper nigrum creams, derived from the black pepper plant, have been used to treat asthma due to their anti-inflammatory and bronchodilatory properties, which help to relax the airway muscles and improve breathing. The bioactive constituents of piper nigrum creams, such as piperine and beta-carboline alkaloids, contribute to their therapeutic effects by inhibiting the release of pro-inflammatory mediators and increasing the production of nitric oxide, a potent bronchodilator. By reducing inflammation and promoting bronchodilation, piper nigrum creams help to alleviate the symptoms of asthma, including wheezing, coughing, and shortness of breath. The benefits of using piper nigrum creams to treat asthma include reduced reliance on medication, improved lung function, and enhanced quality of life for individuals suffering from this chronic condition.
